title: Agent roster for a smoke run
description: Human-authored, not a stage output. The three roles smoke requires: a weak baseline that should fail nearly everything, the agent under test, and an oracle handed the reference answer that should pass nearly everything. Each command is an argv list; smoke substitutes {task_dir}, {logs_dir} and {scenario_id} into each element and expects the command to write a stream-json transcript into {logs_dir} or to stdout. Because a person wrote this file, a schema failure here is a usage error (exit 2) rather than a finding -- there is no stage to send a repair prompt to.

command.description: argv. prefixItems bounds only the executable, which must be a non-empty string; later elements may legitimately be empty. The executable must be runnable as written -- a bare name on PATH or a path with the executable bit -- because smoke's preflight resolves it and refuses the whole roster before any agent runs, which happens before any {task_dir}/{logs_dir}/{scenario_id} substitution. Use a placeholder only in the arguments after the executable.
